verdict.rationale: 1Password documents several programmatic surfaces for this: SDKs in Go, JavaScript and Python to 'programmatically manage items', a Connect Server private REST API for items and vaults, Service Accounts for automation, and the scriptable op CLI. Together these cover an agent storing and updating credentials. One-time passwords are a documented item type, but the evidence never shows them being created programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of create/update calls (the CLI reference excerpt only shows `op item list`), evidence of seeding TOTP secrets via CLI/SDK/API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven item writes.
